  -- Seed: direct subclasses of RequestError in the codebase
  SELECT base_symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases

FROM code.symbols
WHERE symbol_id IN (
  SELECT base_symbol_id FROM exception_tree

request:
Which classes inherit from httpx's `RequestError` exception (httpx/_exceptions.py), either directly or through any number of intermediate classes? Exclude RequestError itself. Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query uses a recursive CTE to walk the class inheritance graph starting from httpx._exceptions.RequestError. It first selects all direct base classes named RequestError, then repeatedly finds their own bases, collecting every ancestor. The final SELECT retrieves the symbol IDs of all classes found in the tree, excluding RequestError itself.

  UNION ALL

  -- Recurse: find subclasses of any class already in the tree
  SELECT cb.base_symbol_id
  FROM code.class_bases cb
  JOIN exception_tree et ON cb.base_symbol_id = et.base_symbol_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT symbol_id
FROM code.symbols
WHERE symbol_id IN (
  SELECT base_symbol_id FROM exception_tree
)
AND symbol_id != (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE qualname = 'httpx._exceptions.RequestError');
